landing.heroSub: Hyperlocal weather for avocados, citrus and vegetables in the Quillota valley. Frost risk, ET and spray windows by orchard block — not by municipality.
landing.liveSubPanel: Same readout as the main dashboard · avocado threshold · OpenMeteo
landing.liveAlertRest: Temperature below bloom damage threshold. Activate anti-frost irrigation before 03:30.
landing.liveFallback: API unavailable; showing a sample with the same dashboard thresholds.
landing.frostActionHigh: Temperature below damage threshold. Check anti-frost irrigation and alerts in the panel.
landing.frostActionMed: Watch: min T° near threshold. Monitor in the agriculture panel.
landing.accessDesc: The same secure JWT entry as before: weather, agriculture and valley monitoring panel.
landing.accessHint: Access is by authorized account. Request credentials from your METGO admin.
landing.modulesDesc: Each module answers an operational decision — not just a weather number.
landing.featFrostBody: Minimum temperature forecast by block with alerts before crop- and phenology-specific damage thresholds.
landing.featEtBody: Daily ETo and water balance to tune irrigation by sector and avoid deficit or excess.
landing.featSprayBody: Hours with favorable wind and humidity to avoid drift and loss of product efficacy.
landing.featPdfBody: PDF weather record per event for crop insurance and field traceability.
landing.howDesc: Four steps from registering your orchard to the alert you get in the field.
landing.step1Body: Block GPS, crop and variety. No own sensors required to start.
landing.step2Body: Nearest station plus valley forecast model, updated every 15 minutes.
landing.step3Body: WhatsApp or email when the projected condition crosses your crop threshold.
landing.step4Body: Act, delay or protect — and keep a PDF event report for documentation.
landing.alertsDesc: Clear signals to act on time, aligned with your crop threshold.
landing.alertOkDesc: Temperatures above damage threshold. Continuous monitoring without intervention.
landing.alertWarnDesc: Approaching threshold. Check anti-frost systems and shift staff.
landing.alertBadDesc: Projected threshold crossing. Activate protection and document the event.
landing.faq1q: Do I need sensors on the block to start?
landing.faq1a: No. You can start with valley stations and the hyperlocal model; own sensors integrate later.
landing.faq2a: Use Sign in with your authorized METGO account. If self-register is enabled, request access via Register.
landing.faq3q: What do I see after login?
landing.faq3a: The Quillota general panel: weather, agriculture, alerts, IoT and modules connected to the METGO API.
landing.ctaTitle: Try it on your next block
landing.ctaSub: Pilot access for Quillota and Aconcagua Valley growers.
